requirement: Press once to start blinking; press again to stop blinking and turn the LED off.
sysml:
attribute flashing : Boolean := false;
out attribute io_1 : Boolean = false;
trigger: first press toggles flashing to true
expected: the LED blinks while flashing is true
actual: io_1 remains false because its expression never reads flashing

requirement: D2 turns the LED on and it stays on until D3 turns it off.
sysml: out attribute io_2 : Boolean = (if io_0 ? true else (if io_1 ? false else false));
model_quote: (if io_0 ? true else (if io_1 ? false else false))
trigger: press D2 and then release it without pressing D3
actual: the expression returns false as soon as D2 is released

requirement: Read the temperature and emit a serial report every 5 seconds.
sysml:
then if accumulatedMs >= 5000 { then assign accumulatedMs := accumulatedMs - 5000; }
out attribute serial_0_trigger : Boolean = accumulatedMs >= 5000;
trigger: a step advances accumulatedMs from below 5000 to 5000
expected: serial_0_trigger is true for that report instant
actual: the ordered update subtracts 5000 before output evaluation, so the trigger is false

requirement: Increment the displayed counter once for each press of the D2 button.
sysml: then if ((io_0) and ((not previousPressed))) { then assign counter := counter + 1; }
trigger: a pull-up button is physically pressed LOW
expected: the normalized model input becomes true on press
actual: the frozen binding declares active_high=true, so HIGH rather than LOW maps to true
